mainEntity.name: Can we create our own cosmic academy artwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Develop your own rocket, astronaut, comic or academy graphic direction. Supply authorized logos and approve the panel artwork before sampling.

mainEntity.name: What fabric composition and GSM are used?

acceptedAnswer.text: Confirm fiber percentages, weight, stretch recovery and moisture management against the approved material specification. Request a swatch and fit sample.
The supplied brief specifies four-needle, six-thread flatlock stitching, raglan sleeves and a reinforced extended hem. Verify seam finish, measurements and movement on the sample.

mainEntity.name: Are the detail images production photographs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The two training-floor images are customer photographs. The three close-up illustrations and video are supplied design presentations; refer to the approved physical sample for production details.

mainEntity.name: What did the repeat buyer say?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perfect as always. Have been using this supplier for years and will continue to do so.
